files.authorship: One number per shipped content pack: the count of technology slots in the game data of builds 101.103.48987 and 101.103.54800, read by the project's VER 8.9 reader from lawfully owned, version-verified installations.
files.license: Neutral factual numbers; no source expression retained
files.transformation: The reader decodes the DAT's technology table and keeps only its row count; no names, text, art, data values, or installation fingerprint are retained. The XS start check answers xsGetPlayerNumberOfTechs with this number for previews that use the shipped content pack.
files.reviewer: Reviewed and approved by the project maintainer on 2026-10-23
